name.zh: 克罗地亚 A1 预付 eSIM

tagline.en: EUR 3 eSIM with credit back: a +385 number for low-frequency backup use, keep-alive at ~EUR 2 per cycle
tagline.zh: EUR3 开卡还返余额：+385 备用号，每周期约 EUR2 保号

description.en: A1 Hrvatska (A1 Croatia) sells a prepaid eSIM with a new +385 number entirely online: EUR 3 on the SIM-promo page, QR code and number delivered by email, and the EUR 3 returned as account credit. First activation grants 180 days of full service; later top-ups extend 92 days per EUR 2, and after expiry a 270-day recharge window keeps the number reachable for calls and SMS. No ID upload was observed in practice, making it a popular low-cost backup number for overseas service sign-ups.
description.zh: 克罗地亚 A1（A1 Hrvatska）在线销售带新 +385 号码的预付 eSIM：SIM-promo 页 EUR3 下单，二维码与号码发到邮箱，EUR3 返还为话费余额。首次激活得 180 天正常使用期；后续每充 EUR2 延 92 天；到期后还有 270 天恢复窗口，窗口内可接电话/短信、可充值复活。实测开卡未见证件上传，是海外服务注册常用的低成本备用号。

details.en:
A1 Hrvatska is the Croatian arm of A1 Group (Telekom Austria), running its own national network. The eSIM flow is fully online: a1.hr/privatni/mobiteli/sim-promo → "Želim novi eSIM broj" → pay EUR 3 (card / Apple Pay / Google Pay) → QR code + number arrive by email → scan to activate. The EUR 3 comes back as account credit, so the effective first-year cost is near zero beyond the initial outlay.

**Validity mechanics (the part most guides get wrong)**: EUR 2 is NOT a 365-day extension. It buys 92 days of full service; after those lapse, a 270-day recharge window follows in which the number can still receive calls and SMS but cannot reliably originate traffic. 92 + 270 = 362 days per EUR 2 cycle — that arithmetic is the whole "EUR 2 per year" trick. For continuous full service, top up EUR 2 every ~80-90 days.

**Top-up**: a1.hr/kupi-bon accepts custom amounts from EUR 2 (fixed vouchers EUR 5/10/15/20/35 with bonus MB online), paid by card, PayPal, Keks Pay or A1 account.

**China roaming field test (2026-08-17)**: on China Mobile the SIM registered but could not receive SMS; on China Unicom, SMS from ChatGPT, Tiger Brokers and BIT arrived, while "你好China" failed. Reception depends on platform risk control and SMS routing — treat it as a receive-mostly backup line, never the sole number for banks, brokers or exchange accounts.

**Practical notes**: no KYC upload observed at order time (rules can change; Croatian registration law still applies formally); eSIM can be activated while roaming abroad; device must support eSIM; moving the profile to another device requires deleting it from the old one first. Sources: a1.hr SIM-promo and kupi-bon pages + third-party tests, verified 2026-08-22.
details.zh:
A1 Hrvatska 是 A1 集团（奥地利电信旗下）的克罗地亚公司，运营自有全国网络。eSIM 流程全线上：a1.hr/privatni/mobiteli/sim-promo → 点 "Želim novi eSIM broj" → 支付 EUR3（信用卡/Apple Pay/Google Pay）→ 二维码+号码发到邮箱 → 扫码激活。EUR3 会返还为账户余额，首年实际成本近乎零。

**有效期机制（多数攻略讲错的部分）**：EUR2 不是 365 天延期。它买的是 92 天正常使用期；到期后跟 270 天恢复窗口，窗口内号码仍可接听来电和短信，但不能稳定主叫/发短信/用数据。92+270=362 天——这就是"EUR2 保一年"的全部算术。要持续完整服务，每 80-90 天充一次 EUR2。

**充值**：a1.hr/kupi-bon 支持自定义金额（最低实测 EUR2；固定档 EUR5/10/15/20/35 在线购送流量），支付方式含卡、PayPal、Keks Pay、A1 账户。

**中国漫游实测（2026-08-17）**：中国移动有信号但收不到短信；中国联通可收 ChatGPT、老虎证券、BIT 的验证码，"你好China"收不到。能否收到取决于平台风控与短信通道——把它当"以收为主"的备用线，绝不做银行、券商、交易所的唯一手机号。

**实用备注**：下单时未见 KYC 证件上传（规则可能变化，克罗地亚实名法规形式上仍适用）；eSIM 可在海外漫游状态激活；设备须支持 eSIM；换设备需先在旧设备删除配置文件。来源：a1.hr SIM-promo 与 kupi-bon 页面+第三方实测，核验于 2026-08-22。
